text: Generate a sequence diagram showing a user logging in through an auth service that queries a database
A User sends a login request to the AuthService which calls the UserRepository to validate credentials
The API gateway receives a request, forwards it to the order service, which responds with a confirmation
Client calls the payment processor, the payment processor contacts the bank, bank returns approval
Show how a customer places an order: customer sends order to cart, cart calls inventory, inventory returns availability
Create a class diagram for an e-commerce system with User, Order, Product, and Cart classes
Model a Vehicle class that has a method drive() and an attribute speed. Car extends Vehicle. Truck extends Vehicle.
There is an abstract Animal class. Dog and Cat inherit from Animal. Each has a method speak().
A BankAccount class has an owner, balance, and methods deposit() and withdraw(). SavingsAccount extends BankAccount.
Design a class hierarchy: Shape is abstract. Circle and Rectangle implement Shape. Both have a method area().
Create an ER diagram for a university database with Student, Course, Enrollment, and Professor tables
Database schema: Customer table has primary key id. Order table has foreign key customer_id referencing Customer.
Design an entity-relationship diagram for a library system with Book, Member, and Loan records
A Product table has columns id, name, price. An Order table has a foreign key to Product with many-to-many cardinality via OrderItem.
Model the schema for a hospital: Patient, Doctor, Appointment. A patient can have many appointments. A doctor attends many appointments.
Show a use case diagram for an online banking system with actors: Customer and Admin
Actors in the system are Customer and Manager. Customer can place order, view history, cancel order.
The stakeholders are Student and Librarian. Student can search books and borrow books. Librarian can add and remove books.
Identify scenarios for a ticket booking system: User can search events, book tickets, and cancel booking.
System boundary is the ATM. Actor is the Bank Customer. Goals include withdraw cash, check balance, deposit cash.
Show a component diagram for a microservices architecture with API Gateway, Auth Service, Order Service, and Notification Service
The system consists of a frontend module, a backend API layer, a business logic layer, and a data access layer
Diagram the subsystems: UserInterface depends on API package. API depends on ServiceLayer. ServiceLayer depends on Database module.
There are three microservices connected via message bus: InventoryService, PaymentService, and ShippingService
Show a deployment diagram for a cloud application deployed on AWS with EC2 instances, RDS database, and a load balancer
The application is deployed on a Kubernetes cluster with three nodes. Each node runs Docker containers.
Infrastructure: web server on AWS, PostgreSQL on RDS, static files on S3. Load balancer routes traffic to the server.
A virtual machine hosts the application server. The application server connects to a database server on a separate node.
Show how an admin logs in, navigates to the dashboard, and exports a report. The system calls the report service which queries the database.
Employee class has attributes name and salary. Manager extends Employee and adds a department field and a method approve().
Invoice table has a primary key and a foreign key to Customer. Each invoice has many line items in the InvoiceItem table.
Actors are Guest and RegisteredUser. Guest can browse products. RegisteredUser can add to cart and checkout.
The frontend bundle depends on the authentication service library. The authentication service depends on the user management module.
Deploy the app to Azure App Service with Azure SQL Database as the backend. Use Azure CDN for static assets.
A notification service sends an email when a user registers. The registration service calls the notification service after saving to the database.
Design a class for a shopping cart: Cart has a list of Items. Item has name, price, quantity.
Schema for a blog: Post table, Comment table with foreign key to Post, User table. A user can write many posts.
Functional requirements: Admin can manage users, view reports. Regular user can update profile and view content.
Architecture: client application, REST API, business services, repository layer, and PostgreSQL database as packages
On-premise server runs the Java application. Firewall separates the server from the internet. Database is on a separate host.
